title: A Visit Counter
prompt: Design a service that counts visits to one page and shows the total.
facts: About 100 visits per second at peak
The total may be up to 5 seconds old

requirements: Count every visit; show a total at most 5 seconds old
estimation: 100 writes per second is small for one database
design: One server and one database are enough
data: One counter row, updated with a single increment
tradeoffs: A lost server loses no counts once written

fullMarkDesigns: One server increments one database row per visit; the page reads the row.
One server counts in memory and writes the sum to the database every second.

reference.design: One server increments a counter row; the page reads it.
alternatives: Count in memory and write every second: fewer writes, may lose a second
